verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents REST APIs (Data API, Admin API) with human-readable REST references and client libraries, but nothing about a downloadable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI or a discovery document. The probe found that every candidate OpenAPI path returned 404. Client libraries and REST reference pages are adjacent developer resources, not a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
